The main failsafe topics are listed below. Note Once a Radio Failsafe, Battery Failsafe, GCS Failsafe or Terrain Data Loss Failsafe is entered and the failsafe action taken involves a mode change to the vehicle, it remain in that mode until the pilot changes the mode directly.
